blocks.text: The Marcos administration has less than two years left to pull the country out of the rut that it is stuck in and leave on a high note, yet it has bewilderingly found time for the Cabinet to play another round of musical chairs. On Monday, “high performing” Secretaries Vince Dizon and Giovanni Lopez swapped places as President Marcos was “shifting gears to accelerate reform.” Dizon is taking back the reins of the Department of Transportation “to fix the daily commute,” while Lopez will transfer to the embattled Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) “to make sure the reforms there […]...
